title: Sparkly lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lemonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF176'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFE94A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8C400'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- lemon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='24' fill='url(#lemonGrad)'/>
  <!-- pointy tips -->
  <path d='M20 52 Q14 47 16 42 Q21 46 24 50 Z' fill='#F5D93A'/>
  <path d='M80 52 Q86 47 84 42 Q79 46 76 50 Z' fill='#F5D93A'/>
  <path d='M23 60 Q15 66 18 72 Q24 66 27 62 Z' fill='#F0CE2E'/>
  <path d='M77 60 Q85 66 82 72 Q76 66 73 62 Z' fill='#F0CE2E'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#FFFCE0' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-25 40 42)'/>
  <!-- texture dimples -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='60' r='1.6' fill='#D9B400' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='64' r='1.4' fill='#D9B400' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='1.4' fill='#D9B400' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='58' r='1.3' fill='#D9B400' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- leaf on top -->
  <path d='M50 27 Q58 18 68 22 Q60 28 50 27 Z' fill='#7ED957'/>
  <path d='M50 27 Q42 18 32 22 Q40 28 50 27 Z' fill='#5FC93B'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='27' x2='50' y2='34' stroke='#8B6B00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkle 1 large -->
  <g fill='#FFFAF0'>
    <path d='M22 20 L24.5 27 L31.5 29.5 L24.5 32 L22 39 L19.5 32 L12.5 29.5 L19.5 27 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 2 -->
  <g fill='#FFF9D6'>
    <path d='M82 18 L83.8 23.2 L89 25 L83.8 26.8 L82 32 L80.2 26.8 L75 25 L80.2 23.2 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 3 small -->
  <g fill='#FFFAF0'>
    <path d='M78 78 L79.5 82 L83.5 83.5 L79.5 85 L78 89 L76.5 85 L72.5 83.5 L76.5 82 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 4 tiny -->
  <g fill='#FFF3B0'>
    <path d='M18 80 L19 83 L22 84 L19 85 L18 88 L17 85 L14 84 L17 83 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 5 mini -->
  <g fill='#FFF9D6'>
    <path d='M88 58 L89 61 L92 62 L89 63 L88 66 L87 63 L84 62 L87 61 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
